lines.en: label christmastwo19:
scene yasuseesinthedark1
I make my way back to the room to find the hall eerily quiet.
lines.zh: 我回到房间，却发现走廊安静得有些诡异。

lines.en: The sound of laughter and enthusiastic non-Christmas karaoke which reverberated off of these walls the last time I allowed myself to be surrounded by them is no more.
lines.zh: 上一次我让自己被这些人包围时，还在四壁之间回荡的笑声，和那热情洋溢的「非圣诞」卡拉OK，如今已荡然无存。

lines.en: It’s blank. And cold. And empty.
lines.zh: 一片空白。寒冷。空荡。

lines.en: And, at the risk of sounding broody- reminds me a lot of the person I see every time I look in the mirror.
lines.zh: 而且——虽然这么说可能显得我很阴郁——这让我想起了每次照镜子时看到的那个人。

lines.en: Or one of them at least.
lines.zh: 至少是其中之一吧。

lines.en: Sometimes, I see something else.
lines.zh: 有时候，我会看到别的什么。

lines.en: I forget it immediately after.
lines.zh: 但转瞬之间就忘得一干二净。

lines.en: If only you understood what that meant.
lines.zh: 要是你能明白那意味着什么就好了。

lines.en: I stand in front of the door for a moment, hoping to hear any sort of sound escaping the confines of the stuffy, overheated room.
lines.zh: 我在门前站了一会儿，盼着能有任何一丝声音，从那间闷热过头的屋子里漏出来。

lines.en: I realize I’ve been gone for a while, but I didn’t think I’d been gone long enough to warrant the party ending without me.
lines.zh: 我知道自己离开有一阵子了，但没想到会久到让派对在我没回来的时候就散了场。

lines.en: If no one is here, where did they go? {i}Why{/i} did they go there?
lines.zh: 如果这里一个人都没有，那她们去哪儿了？{i}为什么{/i}要去那儿？

lines.en: And why am I more focused on the possibilities than taking it upon myself to look?
lines.zh: 还有，为什么我更在意那些可能性，而不是自己动身去找找看？

lines.en: scene black
I move toward the door and touch it.
lines.zh: 我走向门，伸手触碰。

lines.en: It’s so warm that I forget how cold everything was just moments ago.
lines.zh: 它是那样温暖，让我瞬间忘却了片刻之前的一切寒冷。

lines.en: I open it.
lines.zh: 我推开它。

lines.en: It opens me in return.
lines.zh: 而它也反过来推开了我。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark2
As if on cue, a song starts once I enter the room- though the person holding the microphone is not one that I would expect.
lines.zh: 像是早有安排一般，我一进屋，歌声就响了起来——只是握着麦克风的那个人，并不在我的意料之中。

lines.en: Yasu’s frail body is enveloped by the glow of the television, making her snow white dress and hair both significantly paler than they already are.
lines.zh: 电视的荧光笼罩着 Yasu 单薄的身体，让她雪白的连衣裙和头发都显得比原本更加苍白。

lines.en: For someone who hates the color white, she sure pulls it off well.
lines.zh: 一个讨厌白色的人，居然能把白色驾驭得这么好。

lines.en: As well as possible while being a complete fucking lunatic, I mean.
lines.zh: 我是说，在一个彻头彻尾的疯子所能做到的范围内，算是相当好了。

lines.en: I guess she’s a cute lunatic, though.
lines.zh: 不过，她应该算是个可爱的疯子吧。

lines.en: I can’t say that standing alone in a dark room and whispering into a microphone is a hobby that I admire or understand, but I guess it’s a little endearing when approached from the right angle.
lines.zh: 我得说，一个人站在黑屋子里对着麦克风低声哼唱，这种爱好我既欣赏不来也理解不了——不过换个角度看，倒也有几分惹人怜爱。

lines.en: The right angle being ten feet behind her, I mean.
lines.zh: 我说的「换个角度」，是指站在她身后十英尺的地方。

lines.en: If I moved any closer, I worry that the residual warmth I peeled off of the door might melt her skin off.
lines.zh: 要是再靠近一点，我怕自己从门上蹭来的余温会把她的皮给烫化了。

lines.en: As always, I am content with just watching, even if I don’t understand everything I see.
lines.zh: 一如既往，只要静静看着，我就心满意足——即便我并不理解眼前看到的一切。

lines.en: It’s no different from how things normally are.
lines.zh: 这和往常没什么两样。

lines.en: Just a little quieter-
lines.zh: 只是更安静了一点——

lines.en: A little whiter.
lines.zh: 也更白了一点。

lines.en: : She’s been waiting all night for a turn to sing.
lines.zh: : 她等了一整晚，就为了轮到自己唱一次。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark3
: Touka?
lines.zh: : Touka？

lines.en: : What brings you back here, Sensei? I had assumed you’d be with the rest of the girls by now.
lines.zh: : 老师，您怎么回来了？我还以为这会儿您该和其余的姑娘们在一起了。

lines.en: : I don’t know where any of them are. I kind of figured you’d all just...stay where I left you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她们在哪儿。我还以为你们会……一直待在我离开时的地方。

lines.en: : Contrary to what you may believe, the world does not revolve around you.
lines.zh: : 和您想的不同，这个世界并不是围着您转的。

lines.en: : There’s a fireworks celebration tonight. And several people were looking forward to you being around to watch it together.
lines.zh: : 今晚有烟花大会。好几个人都盼着您能在场，和大家一起看。

lines.en: Right. There was one of those last year too, wasn’t there?
lines.zh: 对啊。去年也有过一场，不是吗？

lines.en: : Why are {i}you{/i} here then?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}怎么会在这儿？

lines.en: : For Yasu, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是为了 Yasu。

lines.en: : She managed to stay distracted for most of the night, but I couldn’t possibly let her be alone for all of Christmas.
lines.zh: : 她大半个晚上都勉强让自己没闲下来，但我总不能让她整个圣诞节都孤零零一个人。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark4
: Plus, I think fireworks are a rather tacky form of celebration. Dangerous, too.
lines.zh: : 再说，我觉得烟花这种庆祝方式相当俗气。而且还危险。

lines.en: : Of course you do.
lines.zh: : 你当然会这么想。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark5
: She isn’t bad, is she? I find her voice rather relaxing, to be quite honest.
lines.zh: : 她唱得还不错吧？说实话，我觉得她的声音挺让人放松的。

lines.en: : It is certainly unique, if not anything else.
lines.zh: : 就算别的谈不上，那确实是独一无二的。

lines.en: : And to think that it’s her first time. Why, I feel a bit like a proud mother.
lines.zh: : 而且这还是她第一次唱呢。哎呀，我都有点像个自豪的母亲了。

lines.en: : All she needs now is to work on her confidence so she can do this in front of everyone. And maybe turn a few lights on.
lines.zh: : 现在她只需要再练练自信，就能站到所有人面前去唱了。另外最好再开几盏灯。

lines.en: : I don’t really think “confidence” is a word that pops up in Yasu’s mind very often.
lines.zh: : 我可不觉得「自信」这个词会经常出现在 Yasu 的脑子里。

lines.en: : It “pops up” just as often as it does for everyone else.
lines.zh: : 它「出现」的频率和别人一样高。

lines.en: : Why do you think she waited until now to sing when she could have just asked for a turn earlier?
lines.zh: : 您觉得，她明明可以早点开口要一次机会，为什么偏偏等到现在才唱？

lines.en: : I’ve stopped trying to attribute reasons to anything Yasu does.
lines.zh: : 我早就放弃了，不再去给 Yasu 做的任何事找理由。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark6
: Well if you’d {i}like{/i} to know, it’s because she didn’t want to bother anyone.
lines.zh: : 您既然{i}想{/i}知道，那是因为她不想打扰任何人。

lines.en: : You might believe Yasu to be some sort of religious fanatic and, to some extent, that is most assuredly true.
lines.zh: : 您也许觉得 Yasu 是某种宗教狂热分子，从某种程度上说，这确实一点不假。

lines.en: : But there’s another side to everyone, Sensei. And the side Yasu hides behind her psalms and sermons is one that I’ve heard her describe as some sort of...insect on various occasions.
lines.zh: : 但老师，每个人都有另一面。Yasu 藏在那些圣咏和布道背后的那一面，我曾多次听她把自己形容成某种……昆虫。

lines.en: : A cockroach, I believe it was.
lines.zh: : 我记得，是蟑螂。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark7
: And, unfortunately, I understand the comparison. I do not personally agree with it, but I understand it.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我理解这个比喻。我本人并不认同，但我理解。

lines.en: : I have always looked at myself as an outlier of sorts. Someone who does not fit in with others and, in turn, completely destroys the averages of small sample sizes.
lines.zh: : 我一直把自己看作某种离群值。一个无法融入他人的人，甚至会彻底毁掉小样本里的平均值。

lines.en: : I still believe that to a certain extent and have plenty more to learn, but I don’t think Yasu even acknowledges a life in which she stands on the same ground as the other girls.
lines.zh: : 时至今日我在一定程度上仍这么看，也还有很多要学的——但我觉得，Yasu 甚至不承认自己能和别的女孩站在同一片土地上生活。

lines.en: : And I don’t think those girls are in any rush to get to know Yasu either.
lines.zh: : 而那些女孩，我也不觉得她们有多急着去了解 Yasu。

lines.en: : Which makes me very sad, since she admires every single one of them and simply wants to do all of the things they do.
lines.zh: : 这让我非常难过，因为她仰慕她们每一个人，只是想做她们所做的那些事。

lines.en: : The others would probably care a little more about getting to know Yasu if she wasn’t always trying to convert them to her weird religion.
lines.zh: : 如果她不是总想把别人拉进她那个古怪的宗教，其他人大概会更愿意了解一下 Yasu。

lines.en: : She’s just trying to share the one thing she knows about with everyone else.
lines.zh: : 她只是想把自己唯一了解的东西，分享给所有人罢了。

lines.en: : Well, she is very aggressive about it sometimes.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，她有时候确实挺咄咄逼人的。

lines.en: : I suppose she is.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: : But her entire personality is one composed of inconsistencies and curiosities.
lines.zh: : 但她的整个性格，本就是由种种矛盾与古怪拼凑而成的。

lines.en: : Those flashes of confidence become ones of concern once the cameras are off...and the Yasu you are seeing now is the one I wish others could see as well.
lines.zh: : 一旦镜头移开，那些闪现的自信就化作了不安……而您现在看到的这个 Yasu，正是我希望别人也能看到的那个。

lines.en: : You really like her, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很喜欢她吧？

lines.en: : She is a colossal pain in my behind.
lines.zh: : 她是我屁股上巨大的一根刺。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark8
: But she is also the first friend I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 但她也是我此生第一个朋友。

lines.en: : So I suppose I have a bit of a soft spot for her.
lines.zh: : 所以我想，我对她总归是有点心软的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will in due time as well.
lines.zh: : 我相信您迟早也会的。

lines.en: : It may take several more dark rooms and several more karaoke machines, but the day will come.
lines.zh: : 也许还要再经历几间黑屋子、几台卡拉OK机，但那一天终会到来。

lines.en: : Maybe it will.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Whatever happens happens.
lines.zh: : 该来的总归会来。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark9
: So, do you intend to stay here with us? Perhaps you and I could perform some sort of duet once Yasu has had her fill of the microphone?
lines.zh: : 那么，您打算留下来陪我们吗？也许等 Yasu 唱够了，您和我可以来一段二重唱？

lines.en: : I’m not much of a singer. And I also don’t trust that you would have a decent taste in music.
lines.zh: : 我不太会唱歌。而且我也不信你的音乐品味能好到哪儿去。

lines.en: : You would be surprised, Sensei. Mother and I spent quite a few nights with one another listening to popular music. I know many of the hits.
lines.zh: : 您会惊讶的，老师。母亲和我曾有好几个夜晚一起听流行音乐。热门曲目我知道不少呢。

lines.en: : Hearing you say it that way made me somehow trust you even less.
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，我反倒更不信了。

lines.en: : Really, though. Why are you still here?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。您为什么还在这儿？

lines.en: : Half of the class is waiting for you and you managed to stumble upon the two girls who were fine separating themselves from the crowd for the sake of their own personal comfort.
lines.zh: : 半个班的人都在等您，您却偏偏撞上了这两个甘愿为了自己舒坦而离群的女孩。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark10
: Probably because I always manage to stumble upon the one place I shouldn’t be when there are countless others I belong in.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为，明明有无数个我该待的地方，我却总能一头撞进那个不该待的地方。

lines.en: : When you put it that way, perhaps you aren’t all that different from Yasu and me after all?
lines.zh: : 您这么一说，也许您和 Yasu 还有我，其实没那么不一样？

lines.en: : We’re just three people who don’t fit anywhere other than the little worlds we made for ourselves.
lines.zh: : 我们都只是三个无处安身的人，除了各自为自己造出的小小世界。

lines.en: : Sure. Except I’m not the one who made this world.
lines.zh: : 是啊。只不过这个世界不是我造的。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark11
: Would you enjoy it any less if it was one made {i}for{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 如果它是{i}专为您{/i}而造的，您对它的喜爱会减少分毫吗？

lines.en: : Must something be put together by your own two hands for you to accept it? Or can you live in a house someone else built so long as it fits your needs?
lines.zh: : 难道非得亲手拼装起来的东西，您才肯接受吗？还是说，只要合您的心意，别人盖的房子您也能住进去？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Touka. I’m not really in the mood to wax philosophical right now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Touka。我这会儿真没心情谈哲学。

lines.en: : Apologies, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，老师。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark12
: Were you able to deliver the bear, at least? I must say, I grew quite fond of that little fellow over the short time we knew one another.
lines.zh: : 至少那只熊，您送出去了吗？我得说，在我们相识的短短时间里，我已经挺喜欢那小家伙了。

lines.en: : I do hope his new home will be a good one.
lines.zh: : 真心希望他的新家会是个好归宿。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m sure it will be.
lines.zh: : 一定会的。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark13
: Are you serious?
lines.zh: : 你是认真的？

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark14
: I’m so sorry, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 对不起，Makoto！真的对不起！

lines.en: : It was all me, too! Sensei didn’t do anything!
lines.zh: : 全都是我主动的！老师什么都没做！

lines.en: : I just couldn’t hold it back anymore! It was an accident!
lines.zh: : 我就是再也忍不住了！那是个意外！

lines.en: : I’m so sorry! I’m so...so sorry!
lines.zh: : 对不起！我真的……真的对不起！

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark15
: Just tell me what ya want me to do to make it up to you and I will!
lines.zh: : 你说吧，要我怎么补偿你，我都照做！

lines.en: : I never wanted this to happen! I’m just a...fucking idiot! And I never curse, so...so you know I mean it!
lines.zh: : 我从来没想过会变成这样！我就是个……该死的笨蛋！我平时从来不说脏话，所以……所以你知道我是认真的！

lines.en: : Makoto, say something! Please! Even if it’s just yelling at me! I don’t care!
lines.zh: : Makoto，你说句话啊！求你了！哪怕是冲我吼都行！我不在乎！

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark16
: What the fuck am I supposed to say to this? What would {i}you{/i} say if you were me, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你让我他妈的该说什么好？Miku，换作是{i}你{/i}，你会说什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know...I’ve got no friggin’ idea...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我他妈一点头绪都没有……

lines.en: : I just...couldn’t keep it from you anymore...
lines.zh: : 我只是……再也没法瞒着你了……

lines.en: : I’ve liked Sensei for a while...and I thought I’d be able to kinda like...force it away or somethin’, but...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢老师已经有一阵子了……我还以为自己能……硬把这念头压下去什么的，可是……

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark17
: That’s not how it works, Miku.
lines.zh: : 事情不是这么运作的，Miku。

lines.en: : You can’t just force your feelings to not exist if they make things harder for you. That sort of thing kills people.
lines.zh: : 你不能因为这份感情让你为难，就硬逼着它不存在。这种事是会毁掉一个人的。

lines.en: : I’ve obviously known that you like Sensei for a while, but...
lines.zh: : 我当然早就知道你喜欢老师了，可是……

lines.en: : I guess...this part of the relationship came a lot sooner than I expected...
lines.zh: : 我想……这段关系走到这一步，比我预想的要早得多……

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark18
: You {i}expected{/i} this?!
lines.zh: : 你早就{i}预料到{/i}了？！

lines.en: : You know, after finding you half naked with him that one time, yeah. I kind of did.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，自从那次撞见你跟他半裸着——是啊，我算是预料到了。

lines.en: : We talked about that, though! It was just a misunderstanding!
lines.zh: : 可那件事我们说清楚了啊！那就是个误会！

lines.en: : Are you really going to lie about that again? Right now?
lines.zh: : 你真的还要在这件事上再撒一次谎吗？就现在？

lines.en: : Don’t you think now would be a good time to come clean about it since you literally just admitted to kissing him like two minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 你两分钟前才刚承认亲了他，难道不觉得现在正是坦白的好时机吗？

lines.en: : Okay, fine! It wasn’t an accident! But I’ve messed up enough and I’m already worried you’re gonna hate me for it!
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧！那不是意外！可我已经搞砸够多了，而且我已经在担心你会因此恨我了！

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark19
: {i}Hate{/i} you? Do you really think I could do that?
lines.zh: : {i}恨{/i}你？你真觉得我做得出那种事？

lines.en: : And for something as small as liking the same person as me?
lines.zh: : 而且就为了「和我喜欢上同一个人」这么点小事？

lines.en: : It’s not small, though...you love him...
lines.zh: : 这可不是小事啊……你爱他……

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i} love him?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}爱他吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t think so?...
lines.zh: : 我……应该不算吧？……

lines.en: : I don’t know...I’m still new to feelin’ this way...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我对这种感觉还很陌生……

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark20
: Then I guess I’ve got a head start.
lines.zh: : 那我大概算是领先一步了。

lines.en: : Just so you know, though, I’m not going to take it easy on you just because you’re my best friend.
lines.zh: : 不过我先说清楚，我不会因为你是我的闺蜜就对你手下留情。

lines.en: : ...What?
: What are you...sayin’ right now?...
lines.zh: : 你这话……是什么意思？……

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark21
: That you can try as hard as you want, but I’m still going to win.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你想怎么努力都行，但最后赢的人还是会是我。

lines.en: : I’m already used to fighting for Sensei’s affection. One more person doesn’t mean anything to me.
lines.zh: : 为了老师的心意去争，我早就习惯了。多一个人对我来说不算什么。

lines.en: : Makoto-
lines.zh: : Makoto——

lines.en: : And stop crying, already. You know I hate when you do that.
lines.zh: : 还有别哭了。你知道我最烦你哭。

lines.en: : You’re crying too, though...
lines.zh: : 可你自己也在哭啊……

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark22
: I’m allowed to cry. I just found out that my best friend likes the same person as me.
lines.zh: : 我当然可以哭。我刚得知我最好的闺蜜和我喜欢上了同一个人。

lines.en: : I knew it! You do hate me after all!
lines.zh: : 我就知道！你果然还是恨我！

lines.en: scene black
scene yasuseesinthedark23
: Oh god...I’m...gonna throw up...
lines.zh: : 天哪……我……要吐了……

lines.en: : Please don’t. There are people down there.
lines.zh: : 别吐。下面有人。

lines.en: : There are...hic...people {i}everywhere...Futaba...
lines.zh: : {i}到处……嗝……都是人啊……Futaba……{/i}

lines.en: : That’s why...they’re called...hic...{i}people{/i}...
lines.zh: : 所以……嗝……才叫{i}人{/i}啊……

lines.en: : You...really stop making sense when you’re drunk, huh?...
lines.zh: : 你……一喝醉就真的开始胡言乱语了，是吧？……

lines.en: : Am I mad? That you’re too embarrassed by your sexuality to tell your parents that you’re dating a girl? Yeah, I kind of am.
lines.zh: : 我生气了吗？气你因为自己的性向感到丢人，连告诉父母你在和一个女生交往都不敢？是啊，我确实有点生气。

lines.en: : Oh, so it would be fine if I had a dick? It’s the fact that I {i}don’t{/i} that means your parents will dislike me? Why the fuck do they even care?
lines.zh: : 哦，所以我要是有根鸡巴就没事了？就因为我{i}没有{/i}，你父母就会讨厌我？他们他妈的凭什么管这些？

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark24
: Well, then tell them we’re friends! Or are you not allowed to have any of those either?!
lines.zh: : 那就告诉他们我们是朋友啊！还是说你连朋友都不许有？！

lines.en: : Yeah, I am yelling! I’m hurt and embarrassed!
lines.zh: : 对，我就是在吼！我又伤心又难堪！

lines.en: : And stop bringing my moms up! They don’t have anything to do with us!
lines.zh: : 还有别再提我妈了！她们跟我们之间的事没有任何关系！

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark25
: Of course I still want there to be an {i}us!{/i} I just want the {i}other{/i} half of the {i}us{/i} to not think that there {i}being{/i} an {i}us{/i} is something to be ashamed about!
lines.zh: : 我当然还想有{i}「我们」{/i}！我只是希望「我们」的{i}另一半{/i}，别觉得{i}「我们」的存在{/i}是什么见不得人的事！

lines.en: : Well then fucking prove it, Otoha! I’m not the one who started this! You are!
lines.zh: : 那就他妈的证明给我看啊，Otoha！先挑起这件事的人不是我！是你！

lines.en: : I just wanted to meet my girlfriend’s parents, which is apparently the equivalent of murdering their dog!
lines.zh: : 我只是想见见我女朋友的父母，显然这跟杀了他们家的狗是同等大罪！

lines.en: : It was a figure of speech! I’m not going to hurt their dog!
lines.zh: : 那只是个比喻！我不会去伤害他们家的狗！

lines.en: : Rin, do you want me to talk to her? I can probably be a little more...calm than you are.
lines.zh: : Rin，要我替你跟她说吗？我大概能比你……冷静一点。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark26
: No, Futaba. It’s fine...
lines.zh: : 不用了，Futaba。没关系……

lines.en: : I like you too. A lot.
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢你。很喜欢。

lines.en: : But I don’t like the idea of you being ashamed of me. That hurts.
lines.zh: : 但我不喜欢你觉得我让你丢脸。那很伤人。

lines.en: : But I have to go now. Your roommate is dying.
lines.zh: : 不过我得走了。你室友快不行了。

lines.en: : Tell her...hic...she’s got...a nice...ass...
lines.zh: : 告诉她……嗝……她屁股……挺翘的……

lines.en: : Nodoka says you have a nice ass.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 说你屁股挺翘的。

lines.en: : Are you sure you want those to be your last words to her?
lines.zh: : 你确定这就要成为你对她说的最后一句话？

lines.en: : I...hic...regret nothing...
lines.zh: : 我……嗝……一点都不后悔……

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : I’ll text you when I get back to the dorm, but you’ll probably be asleep by then.
lines.zh: : 我回宿舍后给你发消息，不过那时候你大概已经睡了。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Goodnight, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那就晚安吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene yasuseesinthedark27
: Feast your eyes on this, Chinami! This magnificent dish is known as the “sausage fest” and, through the wonders of the “Door Dash,” I had it brought here just for us!
lines.zh: : 睁大眼睛瞧瞧这个，Chinami！这道了不起的料理叫做「香肠盛宴」，托「Door Dash」的福，我特意叫来给我们俩享用的！

lines.en: : And I didn’t tip the driver! So we can invest the additional cash into our business!
lines.zh: : 而且我没给司机小费！这样省下来的钱就能投进我们的生意里了！

lines.en: : Chinami is too surprised by how big the food is to tell you to be nicer to essential workers!
lines.zh: : Chinami 被这份量惊得说不出话来，没空提醒你对那些必要工作者好一点了！

lines.en: : The only workers who are essential are the CEOs who keep this world running, Chinami! The people like us!
lines.zh: : 唯一「必要」的工作者，是让这个世界运转起来的那些 CEO，Chinami！就是你我这样的人！

lines.en: : I’m glad to see they’re getting along well.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到她们相处得这么好。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want a drink, though, dear? It might help...assist with the noise.
lines.zh: : 不过亲爱的，你真的不喝一杯吗？也许能……帮你盖过这些噪音。

lines.en: : Oh, no. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 哦，不用了。我没事。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark28
: And, for some strange reason, I feel like I’ve already been drunk in this room before.
lines.zh: : 而且不知为何，我总觉得自己以前就在这间屋子里醉过一次。

lines.en: : I just...don’t remember {i}when.{/i}
lines.zh: : 只是……想不起来是{i}什么时候{/i}了。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark27
: That aside, why aren’t you with the rest of your class? Shouldn’t you be focusing on making memories with them instead of an old woman?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你怎么没和班上其他人在一起？你不是该专心和她们制造回忆吗，而不是陪着一个老太婆？

lines.en: : Oh, stop. You’re not even that old.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么说。你根本没那么老。

lines.en: : I’d rather be with you right now anyway. It’s good to take a break from all of the...class drama every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 反正我现在更想和你待在一起。偶尔从那些……班级破事里喘口气也好。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark29
: Oh, sweetie. I’ve watched enough American teen dramas to know that you’re talking about love.
lines.zh: : 哦，亲爱的。我看过的美国青春剧够多了，知道你说的是爱情。

lines.en: : And if Yumi is out there right now and {i}you’re{/i} not...it must be pretty juicy.
lines.zh: : 而且既然 Yumi 这会儿在外头而{i}你{/i}在这儿……那事情一定相当有料。

lines.en: : Hahah...{i}juicy{/i} probably isn’t the right word...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……{i}「有料」{/i}大概不是合适的词……

lines.en: : I’m just trying to give him a little space right now since I...can be kind of a lot sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我只是想给他一点空间，因为我……有时候确实挺让人吃不消的。

lines.en: : I get it, though. I’ve been all over the place lately. It’s just...tough, you know?
lines.zh: : 不过我理解。我最近状态一直起起伏伏的。只是……挺难的，你懂吗？

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark30
: Like...you think a boy will want one thing, but they want the complete opposite.
lines.zh: : 就像……你以为男生会想要一样东西，结果他们想要的恰恰相反。

lines.en: : Oh my, are we talking about the WAP again?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我们又开始聊「那个 WAP」了吗？

lines.en: : Tsubasa, please stop calling it “the WAP.” It’s weird and gross.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa，别再叫它「WAP」了。又怪又恶心。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not as if I can address it by its proper name with two {i}wizards{/i} in the room.
lines.zh: : 可屋里有两位{i}「巫师」{/i}在，我总不好直呼它的本名吧。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark31
: Okay, yeah. Fair point.
lines.zh: : 好吧，嗯。有道理。

lines.en: : What...do you think I should do, though?
lines.zh: : 不过……你觉得我该怎么办？

lines.en: : Like...needing space isn’t some kind of code for not liking me anymore, is it?
lines.zh: : 比如说……需要空间，不会是「不再喜欢我了」的某种暗号吧？

lines.en: : Not at all, dear. Too much of anything can get a little hard to handle at times.
lines.zh: : 完全不是，亲爱的。任何东西太多了，有时候都会有点难以承受。

lines.en: : But if you two are right for one another, things will work out.
lines.zh: : 但如果你们俩真的合适，事情总会有结果的。

lines.en: : If you respect his boundaries, he’s sure to respect you.
lines.zh: : 你尊重他的界限，他也一定会尊重你。

lines.en: : But...what if we’re {i}not{/i} right for each other? How am I supposed to know that?
lines.zh: : 可是……如果我们{i}并不{/i}合适呢？我该怎么才能知道？

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark32
: Oh, honey. I’ve heard the two of you enough to know that is definitely {i}not{/i} the case.
lines.zh: : 哦，宝贝。光是听你们俩的那些动静，我就知道绝对{i}不是{/i}这么回事。

lines.en: : Thanks, Tsubasa...I always appreciate you reminding me of that...
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Tsubasa……你总能让我想起这一点，我很感激……

lines.en: scene black
scene yasuseesinthedark33
Yasu finishes her song and turns around to find me.
lines.zh: Yasu 唱完了歌，转过身来发现了我。

lines.en: I guess she was in too much of a trance to notice Touka and me talking through the entire song, because she seems rather shocked by my sudden appearance.
lines.zh: 大概她太过投入，整首歌的时间里都没注意到 Touka 和我一直在说话，所以对我的突然出现显得相当震惊。

lines.en: Either that or she’s just being weird again.
lines.zh: 要么就是她又在犯怪了。

lines.en: But, as a favor to Touka, I’ll go ahead and assume the former this time.
lines.zh: 不过，就当是给 Touka 一个面子，这次我就当前者吧。

lines.en: : You heard...
lines.zh: : 你都听到了……

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 听到了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : Why are you apologizing?
lines.zh: : 为什么要道歉？

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark34
: I’m not very good.
lines.zh: : 我唱得不好。

lines.en: : That’s not true.
lines.zh: : 才不是。

lines.en: : You did a lot better than I could.
lines.zh: : 你比我强多了。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark35
: Heheh...hehhahhhahah...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……嘿哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Your laugh could still use a little work, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你的笑声还需要再练练。

lines.en: scene yasuseesinthedark36
: I will practice.
lines.zh: : 我会练的。

lines.en: : Well...keep at it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那就继续加油吧。

lines.en: : Someone is waiting for you, you know.
lines.zh: : 有人在等你，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Hm?
: On the rooftop.
lines.zh: : 在屋顶上。

lines.en: : I can hear the footsteps from all the way down here. Somewhere between the top and the bottom.
lines.zh: : 我从这么下面都能听见脚步声。在顶层和底层之间的什么地方。

lines.en: : They’re light, but purposeful. Sad, yet full of hope.
lines.zh: : 那脚步很轻，却带着目的。悲伤，却又满是希望。

lines.en: Right. Fuck.
lines.zh: 对了。操。

lines.en: I was supposed to meet Maya on the roof after I finished talking to Niki.
lines.zh: 我本来和 Niki 谈完之后，要去屋顶见 Maya 的。

lines.en: I must have gotten sidetracked somewhere down the line.
lines.zh: 我一定是在中途的什么地方被岔开了注意力。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: Why does Yasu know that?
lines.zh: Yasu 为什么会知道？

lines.en: : How do you-
lines.zh: : 你怎么会——

lines.en: : All of the other sounds disappeared.
lines.zh: : 其他的声音都消失了。

lines.en: : The rumbling has quieted, leaving nothing but whispers and footsteps.
lines.zh: : 轰鸣平息下来，只剩下低语和脚步声。

lines.en: : Summer is right around the corner.
lines.zh: : 夏天就在拐角处了。

lines.en: : I’ll have to find my parasol.
lines.zh: : 我得把我的阳伞找出来。

lines.en: You know, it’s probably best if I just stop asking Yasu for explanations.
lines.zh: 说真的，我最好还是别再找 Yasu 要解释了。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll...head up to the roof, then.
lines.zh: : 那我……就上屋顶去吧。

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 嗯，去吧。

lines.en: : Count the stairs on your way up.
lines.zh: : 上楼的时候数一数台阶。

lines.en: : Remember to smile.
lines.zh: : 记得要笑。

lines.en: : Will do, Yasu...
lines.zh: : 知道了，Yasu……

lines.en: scene black
I heed Yasu’s advice (Albeit only the first part) and count the stairs on my way up to the roof.
lines.zh: 我听从了 Yasu 的建议（虽然只听了前半句），一边上屋顶一边数台阶。

lines.en: It helps distract me from keeping Maya on top of yet another building for longer than she’d like to be there.
lines.zh: 这让我多少不再去想，自己又把 Maya 晾在另一栋楼的楼顶上，比她愿意待的时间久得多。

lines.en: There were 85 of them, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: 一共有 85 级，如果你想问的话。

lines.en: You should always be wondering.
lines.zh: 你应该永远都想知道。
